RecordDef.label: people carried out of a fight
RecordDef.description: Times this colonist carried someone of the colony out of a fight while it was still going on.

RecordDef.label: night watches kept
RecordDef.description: Nights this colonist walked the walls on watch until morning.

RecordDef.label: contests won
RecordDef.description: Contests of skill this colonist won against someone else: at a feast, a fair, a friendly match.

RecordDef.label: masterworks made
RecordDef.description: Pieces of masterwork quality or better this colonist made, the kind people stop to look at.

RecordDef.label: rounds of the sick
RecordDef.description: Times this colonist went round the sickbeds looking in on each of the sick and wounded.

RecordDef.label: kindnesses to strangers
RecordDef.description: Times this colonist did a stranger a kindness: water for a thirsty traveler, a kind word, a meal, a night's talk.

RecordDef.label: students taught to stand alone
RecordDef.description: Students this colonist taught until they no longer needed a teacher.
